perRequirement.imageRegion: All three seed rows; flame body and surrounding receiver plane.
perRequirement.observation: Reviewed all 24 Beauty images (3 seed rows x 8 frames). Frames 1, 21, 60, 120, and 180 show the flame/receiver presentation changing scale or shifting laterally as a visibly fused planar composition rather than remaining a coherent anchored sustained flame; frames 240, 300, and 360 show stop/cleanup but do not cure the active-state spatial incoherence.
